name: Delta Lake
short_description: An open-source storage layer that extends Parquet files with a transaction log to provide ACID transactions, schema enforcement and table versioning; it is the default table format in Azure Databricks.

evidence.quote: Delta Lake fixes that by extending parquet files with a transaction log
Databricks created a technology named Delta Lake
And the default data format is Delta Parkage.
